description: Finds files and directories using fd with structured output. Returns file paths, names, and extensions.

absolutePath.description: Return absolute paths instead of relative (--absolute-path)

changedWithin.description: Filter by modification time (maps to --changed-within, e.g., '1d', '2h', '30min')

exclude.description: Exclude entries matching this glob pattern (maps to --exclude, e.g., 'node_modules', 'dist')

fullPath.description: Match pattern against full path, not just filename (--full-path)

glob.description: Use glob pattern matching instead of regex (--glob)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 1000)

noIgnore.description: Don't respect .gitignore and other ignore files (--no-ignore)

pattern.description: Regex pattern to match file/directory names

size.description: Filter by file size (maps to --size, e.g., '+1m' for >1MB, '-100k' for <100KB)

type.description: Filter by entry type: file, directory, symlink, executable, or empty

name: find
title: Find Files
